warmup.question: Is 9 odd or even?
warmup.note: 暖身說 odd 就可以，不花時間反覆數數。

activities.title: 公園裡有幾棵樹？
activities.question: How many trees are in the park?
activities.instruction: 數一數，再用一句完整英文回答。
activities.target: There are + 數量 + 複數名詞 + 地點。
activities.answer: There are five trees in the park.
activities.accepted: I can see five trees. 也正確；再邀請他用 There are 說一次。
activities.hint: 只提示 There are...；還卡住才示範完整句。
activities.transfer: 換成桌上的三枝鉛筆：There are three pencils on the table.

activities.title: 看標題，猜主題
activities.question: What do you think the text is about?
activities.heading: Counting Our Toys
activities.instruction: 只看標題，說說你猜文章會介紹什麼。
activities.target: I think it's about + 主題。
activities.answer: I think it's about counting toys.
activities.accepted: I think it's about toys. 或 It's about counting toys. 都可接受。
activities.hint: 先提示 I think it's about...；合理的主題預測都可以。
activities.transfer: 把標題換成 Counting Our Books，再猜一次主題。
activities.evidence: 課堂 15:50-16:55；教材實際第 89 頁的閱讀策略。

activities.title: 玩具太多，箱子蓋不起來
activities.question: Tell me about your toys.
activities.instruction: 假裝這是你的玩具箱，說出「我有太多玩具了」。
activities.target: I have too many + 複數名詞。
activities.accepted: There are too many toys in the box. 也可接受。
activities.hint: 先提示 I have...；需要時再給 too many toys。
activities.transfer: 換成書或帽子：I have too many books / hats.
activities.evidence: 課堂 21:45-22:25；老師在對話中示範 too many toys。
